items.description: Seams C3 exposes so that Component 4 can test generated code independently. C3 does not write or own C4 test truth.

seam_types.SERVICE_INTERFACE: Stable class + method signatures that C4 can import and call.
seam_types.INJECTED_REPOSITORY: Repository passed into the service constructor; C4 may supply a fake.
seam_types.INJECTED_POLICY: Grading policy passed into the service; C4 may supply a controlled policy.
seam_types.API_CONTRACT: OpenAPI operation with stable operationId and error schema.
seam_types.FRONTEND_FORM: Accessible labels and data-testid attributes on interactive elements.
